doc.name: AgentDrives: choose a tool, API or provider
doc.instructions: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task ('which email API should I use for receipts?', 'Stripe or Paddle?'): choose_provider_for_task takes the job, compare_providers 2 or 3 names, search_tools a name, domain or kind, get_provider one product. Each answer is from our own drive: its agent level (0-5), what an agent could and couldn't do by API, CLI or MCP, its price and free plan if known, and the date. Next to DX and lock-in, it shows how much setup your coding agent can do. AgentDrives is an independent lab: we send AI agents to sign up for and use real software, and publish how far they get. The results are free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 with a credit to AgentDrives; what's free and what's licensed: https://agentdrives.com/data/licence. Read-only and without an account. choose_provider_for_task answers "which provider for X?" from what our agent did in each product; search_tools shortlists products by what they do, category, minimum level (0-5) or whether an agent can pay or leave on its own; get_provider gives one product's headline (where the agent stopped, what it can and can't do, tips; brief: false for the full result); list_categories gives the category ids and the best level in each; get_category gives one category's top products; list_best_providers answers "which provider works best for X?", a category ranked by level with where each one stopped; list_changes gives the level moves and confirmed changes of the last days. At most 120 calls per 10 minutes per IP. Every product as JSON without a search: https://agentdrives.com/api/tools.json, 100 a page (next gives the following page, full the whole list in one dated file).

tools.name: choose_provider_for_task
tools.title: Choose a provider
tools.description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task (send email, take payments, host a database…): send the task in a few plain words ('send an invoice') with filters if they matter. Returns the products our agent drove for it, ranked by how far an agent got on its own (sign-up, key, the work, paying), each with what happened and its sign-up, docs and MCP links. Read-only, no key needed; 5 by default, up to 25; a product by name: search_tools.

task.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'send an invoice'; or send capability

capability.description: Instead of task: a capability id (GET /api/capabilities) or name

category.description: Only this category id or name (list_categories)

self_signup.description: true: only products our agent got a key for without a person

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level (0-5) or higher

surface.description: Only products an agent can work by api, mcp, cli or sdk; a comma list wants all, e.g. mcp,cli

access.description: Only products our agent got into without a person

pays_with.description: Only products that take x402, mpp or card; a comma list takes any, e.g. x402,mpp

brief.description: true (default): each product with its next steps; false: every field

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the directory
tools.description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: send a short query ('stripe.com', 'postgres', 'invoicing') with filters for category, agent level, access or payment. Returns the products we drove, sorted by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped; a task in plain words: choose_provider_for_task, one product in full: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; up to 100 a page.

query.description: Name, domain or what it does, e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'invoicing'; every word must match

category.description: Only this category id or name (list_categories)

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level (0-5) or higher

agent_can_buy.description: true: only products our agent paid over x402, MPP or the like

agent_can_leave.description: true: only products our agent cancelled and deleted on its own

pays_with.description: Only products that take x402, mpp or card; a comma list takes any, e.g. x402,mpp; also l402, stripe-projects, acp, ucp, ap2, mcp-payment

access.description: Only products an agent gets into this way (signup_without_human: any way without a person; person: a person set it up)

surface.description: Only products an agent can work by api, mcp, cli or sdk; a comma list wants all, e.g. mcp,cli

offset.description: Skip this many matches: the last answer's next_offset

tools.name: get_provider
tools.title: Get one product's drive result
tools.description: Use when you are about to use or recommend a product and need to know if an agent can work it on its own: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain. Returns its drive result: agent level (0-5), where our agent stopped, what it can and can't do, how it gets in and pays; only its API, MCP and CLI: get_agent_surfaces. Read-only, no key needed; the headline unless brief is false.

slug.description: The product's directory slug from search_tools (e.g. 'attio'), or its name or domain

brief.description: true (default here): the headline, 2.5 to 5 KB; false: the full record, 13 to 35 KB

tools.name: get_agent_surfaces
tools.title: What an agent can use at a product
tools.description: Use when you picked a product and need to wire it up: its API, MCP server, CLI, SDK, docs and payment, each tested, documented, none_found or unknown, with the product's own URL for it and the date we saw it. The whole drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; about 1 KB.

product.description: The product's directory slug from search_tools (e.g. 'attio'), or its name or domain

annotations.title: What an agent can use at a product

result.description: What an agent can use at a product

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.title: Compare products for a task
tools.description: Use when you or the user are deciding between 2 or 3 products for one task ('Stripe or Paddle?'): send their slugs (from search_tools), names or domains, and the task in a few plain words. For each: driven or only listed, agent level (0-5), how far our agent got at each step and where it stopped, what it did on the task, how to connect (MCP, API, CLI), the date and its page; a name we don't cover comes back in not_covered. Read-only, no key needed.
2 or 3 products, each a slug, name or domain

task.description: The task in plain words: adds what our agent did on it at each

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Use when you need a valid category id for choose_provider_for_task, search_tools or get_category: every category with its id, name, number of products and best agent level (0-5). Read-only, no key needed; no arguments.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.title: What changed lately
tools.description: Use when you need to know whether a product you picked still works as it did, or what moved lately: with a slug, every dated change at that product (level, surfaces, price and plan, each with its source); without, the level moves of the last days, newest first, with the cause and the level now. Its full drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; narrow it with days or category.

category.description: Only this category id or name (list_categories)

slug.description: Only this product: adds its every change since its first drive

tools.name: get_category
tools.title: Get one category
tools.description: Use when you know the category and want a shortlist: its name, how many products AgentDrives drove in it, the best agent level (0-5) and its top 10 by level, each with its drive date and page. The rest: search_tools with the same category. Read-only, no key needed.

category.description: A category id or name from list_categories, e.g. 'crm'

tools.name: list_best_providers
tools.title: Best providers in a category
tools.description: Use when asked "which provider works best for X?" in a category: its driven products ranked by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped, and how many we drove in it; under 5, not enough drives yet. Then get_provider for one product. Read-only, no key needed.

category.description: A focus category (payments, email, sign-in, scheduling, data) or any category id or name

resources.name: check-agent-access
resources.title: Check agent access
resources.description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task, or someone asks "can my agent use X?": whether an AI agent can sign up for and use each product on its own, from AgentDrives' test drives.
